title: Unpaid Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) Internship
text:
Demo Co. Willow is an agency building logistics apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is fully remote within the country.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and work closely with design and product.

Modern devices for testing. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
